mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_post_favorite (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_favorite f JOIN tb_post p ON p.post_id = f.post_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
